blocks.prompt: 8. LORAN (long distance radio navigation) for aircraft and ships uses synchronized pulses transmitted by widely separated transmitting stations. These pulses travel at the speed of light (186,000 miles per second). The difference in the times of arrival of these pulses at an aircraft or ship is constant on a hyperbola having the transmitting stations as foci. Assume that two stations, 500 miles apart, are positioned on a rectangular coordinate system at \((-250, 0)\) and \((250, 0)\) and that a ship is traveling on a path with coordinates \((x, 120)\) (a horizontal line 120 miles above the \(x\)-axis). Find the \(x\)-coordinate of the position of the ship when the time difference between the pulses from the transmitting stations is 1200 microseconds (0.0008 second).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh hyperbola ka asal zindagi wala sawal hai.
Qanoon: jin points ka do fixed points se faaslon ka farq hamesha ek jaisa ho, woh hyperbola par hote hain, aur woh do points us ke foci hote hain.
Diya kya hai? Do stations (foci) \((\pm 250, 0)\) par, pulses ki speed, aur pulses ke pohanchne ke waqt ka farq. Ship line \(y = 120\) par chal raha hai.
Find kya karna hai? Ship ka \(x\)-coordinate.
Plan: speed \(\times\) time se faaslon ka farq \(2a\), phir \(b^2 = c^2 - a^2\), phir hyperbola mein \(y = 120\) rakhna.
steps:
Diya gaya: foci \(F'(-250, 0)\), \(F(250, 0)\); speed 186,000 miles/s; waqt ka farq 1200 microseconds; ship \(y = 120\) par.
Maloom karna: ship ka \(x\)-coordinate.
Tareeqa: hyperbola \(\frac{x^2}{a^2} - \frac{y^2}{b^2} = 1\) ke har point \(P\) ke liye \(\big||PF'| - |PF|\big| = 2a\), foci \((\pm c, 0)\) aur \(c^2 = a^2 + b^2\). Ship dono stations se pulses leta hai; waqt ka farq faaslon ka farq batata hai, is liye ship isi hyperbola par hai.

Waqt seconds mein
\[1200\ \mu\text{s} = 1200 \times 10^{-6} \text{ s}\]
\[= 0.0012 \text{ s}\]
Kyun: ek microsecond \(10^{-6}\) second hota hai (micro = das lakh mein ek hissa).
Dhyan dein: sawal ki bracket mein 0.0008 second likha hai, jo ghalat hai; neeche wala correction box dekhein. Hum sahi value 0.0012 s lenge.

Faaslon ka farq
\[2a = 186000 \times 0.0012 = 223.2\]
\[a = 111.6,\quad a^2 = 12454.56\]
Kyun: faasla = speed \(\times\) waqt. Door wale station ka pulse jitna der se pohancha, utne waqt mein usne 223.2 miles zyada safar kiya. Yahi faaslon ka farq hai, aur hyperbola mein yeh \(2a\) hota hai.

\(b^2\) nikalein
\[c = 250,\quad c^2 = 62500\]
\[b^2 = c^2 - a^2 = 62500 - 12454.56\]
\[b^2 = 50045.44\]
Kyun: stations foci hain, \((\pm 250, 0)\), to \(c = 250\). Hyperbola mein \(c^2 = a^2 + b^2\) (ellipse ke ulat), is liye \(b^2 = c^2 - a^2\).

Hyperbola ki equation
\[\dfrac{x^2}{12454.56} - \dfrac{y^2}{50045.44} = 1\]
Kyun: centre origin par (dono stations ke bilkul beech) aur foci \(x\)-axis par hain, is liye yeh standard shakal. Ab har woh jagah jahan pulses ka farq 1200 microseconds ho, isi hyperbola par hai; ship ki line \(y = 120\) is ko jahan kaatti hai, wahi ship ki position hai.

\(y = 120\) rakhein
\[\dfrac{x^2}{12454.56} = 1 + \dfrac{14400}{50045.44}\]
\[= 1.2877385\]
\[x^2 = 12454.56 \times 1.2877385\]
\[x^2 = 16038.22\]
\[x \approx \pm 126.64\]
Kyun: ship line \(y = 120\) par hai, aur \(120^2 = 14400\). \(y\) wala term doosri taraf le gaye to plus ban gaya.
Dhyan dein: beech mein numbers ko zyada round na karein; is liye hum ne 7 decimal tak rakha.

Sign ka faisla
Agar \(F(250, 0)\) ka pulse pehle pohanche to ship \(F\) ke qareeb, right branch par hai: \(x \approx 126.64\). Agar \((-250, 0)\) ka pulse pehle pohanche to \(x \approx -126.64\).
Kyun: sawal yeh nahi batata ke kaun sa pulse pehle aaya. Answer key positive value leti hai.

Tasdeeq
\[|PF'| = \sqrt{376.64^2 + 120^2} \approx 395.30\]
\[|PF| = \sqrt{123.36^2 + 120^2} \approx 172.10\]
\[395.30 - 172.10 = 223.20 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(P(126.64, 120)\) ke dono stations se faaslon ka farq bilkul \(2a = 223.2\) miles aaya, jaisa hona chahiye tha.
blocks.final_answer: \(x \approx 126.64\) miles (ship taqreeban \((126.64, 120)\) par, station \((250, 0)\) ke qareeb); agar ship \((-250, 0)\) wale station ke qareeb ho to \(x \approx -126.64\). Key ka 126.65 beech mein rounding ki wajah se hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal mein '1200 microseconds (0.0008 second)' chhapa hai. Lekin \(1\ \mu\text{s} = 10^{-6}\) s, is liye 1200 microseconds \(= 0.0012\) s hain, 0.0008 s nahi. Key ka jawab (126.65 miles) bhi 0.0012 s se hi aata hai; 0.0008 s lete to \(x \approx 83.27\) miles aata. Is liye bracket mein (0.0012 second) hona chahiye.
